recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Further work should only occur through a new OO decision if the work group wants to change how ServiceRequest distinguishes existing supporting information from orderDetail questions or delivery instructions.
issue_request: FHIR-11132 was a Published, Not Persuasive with Modification OO issue asking whether DiagnosticRequest could represent ordering or collection question information such as pregnancy or fasting status. The resolution said Request.supportingInfo was intended for this information, should carry AOE alternate names/comments, and that the 0..* cardinality change was handled by the related cardinality tracker.
initial_application: No current commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-11132 was found. The requested AOE guidance appears in DSTU2 DiagnosticRequest generated/profile artifacts, the DiagnosticRequest element was renamed from supportingInformation to supportingInfo by later request-pattern work, and DiagnosticRequest/ProcedureRequest content was then carried forward into the active ServiceRequest lineage.
additional_context: ServiceRequest is active and OO-owned in source/fhir.ini, while DiagnosticRequest, ProcedureRequest, and ReferralRequest are documented as subsumed or merged into ServiceRequest. Later final issues FHIR-37355 and FHIR-31589 intentionally changed the current type to CodeableReference(Resource) and clarified that supportingInfo is existing clinical context, with orderDetail used for questions or instructions to be gathered.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml already has ServiceRequest.supportingInfo with max 0..*, AOE aliases, and the ask-at-order-entry clinical-context definition. Adding more FHIR-11132 prose would duplicate the current source and risk weakening the later FHIR-31589 boundary.
